waiting.title: Waiting for you
waiting.detail: Items that need a decision from a PM, the owner, or a tech lead.
waiting.empty: Nothing needs your decision right now.

reason.approve_prd: PRD waiting for approval. One approval from the owner, a PM, or a tech lead is enough.

reason.refine_item: Draft to refine before it is ready.
reason.publish_epic: Epic is ready. Publish it to put its tasks on the board.

how.title: How this project works
how.step1: The PM writes a BRD, and an agent drafts the PRD.
how.step2: The owner, a PM, or a tech lead approves the PRD.
how.step3: An agent breaks the PRD into epics and stories.
how.step4: The PM refines the stories and publishes the epic.
how.step5: Tasks appear on the board for the people assigned.

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyDetail: Start with a BRD. Upload a file or write it here, then let an agent draft the PRD.
documents.emptyReader: The PM has not shared a document yet.

document.discardDetail: The document stays in the record, but it can no longer be edited, reviewed, or used by agents.
document.discardedDetail: Kept for the record and not used by agents. The owner or a PM can delete it for good.
document.deleteDetail: The document, all its versions, and its discussion are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
document.extractedHint: This text was taken from the uploaded file, and it is what agents read. Tables and layout can change, so compare it with the original before you confirm.
document.pdfFailed: The PDF cannot be shown here. Download the file to open it.
document.derivedEmpty: No PRD is based on this document yet.
document.empty: This document has no text yet.
document.agentTitle: An agent wrote this draft. The team has not used it yet.
document.agentDetail: The owner, a PM, or a tech lead approves it before an agent can create epics and stories from it.
document.reviewTitle: This PRD is waiting for approval.
document.approvedDetail: Agents with draft access can now create epics and stories from it.
document.approvalHint: One approval from the owner, a PM, or a tech lead is enough.

itemDialog.detail: Drafts stay off the board until the PM publishes the epic.
itemDialog.name: Title
itemDialog.sectionHint: Optional. It must match text in the PRD word for word.
itemDialog.epicTemplate:
Goal: 
Scope: 
Out of scope: 
Success metrics: 
Done when:
- 
Risks & dependencies:
-
itemDialog.epicHint: Fill in each label. Scope takes requirement ids (R1, R2). Write success metrics as "name (now → target)". Put list items one per line, starting with "- ". Empty labels are not shown.
